name: wowsims-apl
description: The SIML language for rotations, gear sets and sim setups (*.siml): the repository's SIML language server (wowsimcli siml lsp) with diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation, formatting and code actions, and a panel that shows, edits and sims an .apl.siml rotation beside it.

commands.title: WoWSims: Open APL Editor to the Side

wowsims-apl.goBinary.description: The go binary that builds the SIML server (cmd/wowsimcli). `go` searches the PATH, then GOROOT and the usual install directories; set a full path if none of them has it. A full path that does not exist falls back to the same search.

wowsims-apl.server.description: A wowsimcli binary built with --tags=with_db to run as the SIML server (`wowsimcli siml lsp`) instead of the one the extension builds from the repository. Run WoWSims: Restart SIML Server after changing it.

wowsims-apl.simIterations.description: Iterations per sim run from the editor.

wowsims-apl.simSettingsFile.description: Settings exported from the site, as JSON or SIML, which supply the character (gear, talents, race, consumables, buffs, encounter) for sims from the editor; a preset build (builds/*.siml) is loaded over its spec's defaults.siml. Empty uses the spec's defaults.siml, with the one preset build whose rotation is the saved file's loaded over it as the site loads a build.
